errors.text_span: Графиката илюстрира промените в процентите на търговията с няколко групи търговски партньори на България в периода 2004-2019 г.
errors.evidence: The description treats the figure as a single chart, but it actually contains two separate side-by-side charts: one for 'Внос' (Imports) and one for 'Износ' (Exports). This is a fundamental misunderstanding of the figure's structure.
The figure clearly shows five distinct lines, as indicated in the legend.
The description assigns colors (e.g., 'тъмносиво', 'пенливо сиво', 'сиво', 'червено') to the lines, but the figure is presented in grayscale.
The description repeatedly mentions 'кръгли маркери' (round markers), but the lines in the figure do not have any markers.

The description fails to mention the legend or map the different line styles (dotted, solid, dashed, etc.) to their corresponding categories (EC, ОИСР, БРИКС, etc.), making it impossible to identify which line is being described.

errors.text_span: Първата е с цвят тъмносиво, пунктирана, с кръгли маркери и показва линиите, падащи от 78,0% през 2004 г., до 73,0% през 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The description assigns the 'пунктирана' (dotted) style to a line that is described with values in the 70-80% range. In the chart, the dotted line ('EC') is in the 50-70% range, while the line in the 70-90% range ('ОИСР') is solid, not dotted.

errors.text_span: показва стойност от 14,0% през 2004 г. до 26,0% през 2019 г.
errors.evidence: No line in either the 'Imports' or 'Exports' chart starts at approximately 14% in 2004 and ends at 26% in 2019. This is a complete misreading of the data.

errors.text_span: Наблюдава се повишаване до 42%, закъснял в този период от 2012 и 2013
errors.evidence: No line in the chart has a peak of 42% in the 2012-2013 period. For example, the 'ОИСР (без членки на ЕС)' line in the 'Износ' chart peaks around 49% in 2008, not 42% in 2012-2013.

errors.text_span: показва стойност от 50,0% през 2005 г., достигаща най-високата си точка от 61%, през 2009 г. Следва спад до 48% през 2011 г. и стабилизиране на 76% през 2019 г.
errors.evidence: This entire description of the fourth line is factually incorrect. For instance, the 'EC' line (dotted) is around 52% (Imports) or 62% (Exports) in 2005, not 50%. It does not peak at 61% in 2009, and its final value in 2019 is around 63-67%, not 76%.
